text: Small six-week trial of over-65s: daily walks lowered blood pressure, only in people not on medication.
Coffee may improve memory, shown so far only in mice, at doses like eight cups a day.
A Chinese call-centre firm found home-working volunteers were 13 percent more productive, mostly from fewer breaks.
A new bridge cut northern commutes by about four minutes, measured during school holidays.
Small, mixed-quality trials suggest vitamin D prevents colds, only in vitamin-deficient people.
A four-week reading app improved children's letter recognition, not story understanding, for kids already with tutors.
Lab bee colonies given ten times field doses of a pesticide made shorter foraging trips but didn't die.
A four-day week trial in volunteer firms, lacking a comparison group, cut weekly hours from 38 to 34.
